text: 🧱 THE DAILY BLOCK · SAT 10 OCT ₿ BTC $82,691 (+0.2%) · ETH $2,493 (+0.3%) · Fear & Greed 64 🇮🇳 NIFTY 22,520 (+1.3%) · SENSEX 72,472 (+1.2%) at Friday's close ⏱ A year ago today, $3.2B of bets died in 60 seconds. On 10 October 2025 a 100% China tariff post set off crypto's biggest wipeout: over $19 billion force-closed in a day and 1.6 million accounts liquidated. Bitcoin fell from $122,574 to $104,782. 🛡 Your spot coins survived it. Coins bought with your own money can't be force-closed, so spot holders kept every one. Thursday's $1.19B flush was 16 times smaller but the same trap: bets on borrowed money went first. 📉 A year on, bitcoin sits 34% below its $126,080 record, set four days before the crash. 🇮🇳 The Sensex won back 879 points on Friday, a day after its 32-month low, as IT stocks rose 3% and oil eased.
